name: Safaniya Offshore-Onshore Crude Trunkline (CRPO 156)

values.RouteType: Not mapped (but could be — route or endpoints are known)
values.RouteNotes: Start endpoint (Safaniya offshore oil field, Arabian Gulf, off Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province) is named in all three sources; the onshore terminus is described only generically as an onshore processing/receiving facility, not named. No GIS/shapefile route located. Corridor is ~65 km offshore + 12 km onshore (~77 km total) per Saipem's EPCI scope. Do not draw a route until the onshore endpoint is confirmed by name — flagged for a future route-research pass once more detail (e.g. FERC-style project map or Aramco filing) surfaces.

researcher_notes:
New-row: confirmed distinct from all existing Safaniya-area GEM rows. P1958 (Safaniyah-Juaymah Oil Pipeline, 198 km, 46/48-in) and P1964-P1966/P5169 (Safiniyah-Kursaniyah Oil Pipelines, 106 km, 22-48-in, 4 parallel lines) are both far longer than this candidate's ~77 km (65 km offshore + 12 km onshore) and none of the three evidence sources reference either existing line, a rebuild, or an upgrade of them — this is a new physical trunkline under a new EPCI award, not a renaming.

Sponsor/step/geography threshold (Discovery SOP §3): (a) sponsor = Saudi Aramco (client, existing Long-Term Agreement) with Saipem as EPCI contractor, both named in all 3 sources; (b) country + start endpoint = Saudi Arabia, Safaniya offshore oil field (Eastern Province/Arabian Gulf) — named specifically; onshore endpoint is only generically described, not named, so route/EndLocation are left unfilled; (c) concrete step = EPCI contract formally awarded Feb 23, 2026 (Saipem CRPO under its Aramco LTA). All three legs met -> new_row, not monitor.

CRPO project-code check: the candidate's proposed name carries a '(CRPO 156)' suffix from the consolidator note, but I read the full text of all three sources directly (not just the AI summary) looking for a numeric CRPO identifier and none states '156' or any other CRPO number — Saipem's own release calls it simply 'a Contract Release Purchase Order (CRPO)' with no number given. I dropped '(CRPO 156)' from the staged PipelineName since I can't verify that digit against any cited source (best not to carry an unconfirmed number into the tracker); flagging here in case the consolidator has a fourth source with the number that I don't have access to.

Corroboration/independence: Saipem's own press release (primary, company disclosure) states the core facts (48-in, 65 km offshore + 12 km onshore, Safaniya field, Aramco LTA, contract worth ~$500m per the page title) and is verified live. Offshore Engineer explicitly cites the Saipem release and adds no new facts (essentially a reprint) — flagging this so tier isn't overstated. JPT's piece, however, does add independently-reported context beyond the release: it cites Aramco CEO Amin Nasser's 2022 and 2024 remarks to Arab News about the Safaniya increment/expansion program and pulls figures from Aramco's Q3 2025 earnings report on other brownfield increment projects (Marjan, Berri, Zuluf, Dammam phase 2) — showing its own reporting/verification rather than pure republication. On balance this clears the '>=2 independent sources' bar, but since the core physical specs (length/diameter) trace to one origin (Saipem), and the $500m cost figure is stated only in Saipem's own release title (not repeated by either trade outlet), I'm scoring tier=medium rather than high.

Status call: set Status=construction (not proposed) because the CRPO is a signed/awarded EPCI contract, not merely an FID or planning milestone — Aramco/Saipem's LTA framework issues CRPOs as ready-to-execute work orders, and Saipem names its assigned fabrication yard, i.e. execution is mobilizing. FIDStatus left blank per the vocab rule (only populated when Status=proposed). If a QC pass judges the project not yet physically under way as of this writing, ConstructionYear/Month can be reclassified to Status=proposed + FIDStatus=FID with the same refs.

Owner: 'Saudi Aramco' matched via entity_lookup.py to existing entity ID 100 (oil tracker) — reuse, not a new entity; Parent left blank (not restated in these sources, and Owner already captures the identified sponsor).

Route: no official GIS route exists; RouteAccuracy=no route because the onshore terminus is unnamed in reporting (only 'onshore' is stated) so even a basic point-to-point line would be a guess — left for a dedicated route pass once the onshore facility is named.
